dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Mildly concave curvature along the trailing edge from the posterior notch to the apex, exhibiting a standard falcate profile.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a small pixel radius, transitioning smoothly from the leading edge to the trailing edge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: High angular steepness, approximately 70 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base width is approximately 1.2 times the vertical height from base to apex.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Distinctly convex arc with a moderate radius, creating a bulbous appearance.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick rostrum extending from the cranial inflection point with a low length-to-girth ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Clearly defined obtuse angle where the convex melon slope meets the dorsal margin of the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced specular highlights and high-contrast luminosity across the dorsal surface and mid-flank; visible faceted mesh-like edges on fin margins suggesting a digital rendering.
